articles.summary: Adnan Choudhury Joins as a Managing Director in the Business Services Group Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Adnan Choudhury has joined the firm as a Managing Director in its Business Services Group. Based in London, Mr. Choudhury will focus his coverage on professional services across Europe, further strengthening the group’s sector expertise and client reach across the region. Mr. Choudhury brings more than 13 years of investment banking experience, joining from Perella Weinberg Partners, where he was part of the U.K. Advisory team, leading coverage of the services sector. He has built deep expertise advising corporate and financial sponsor clients on a broad range of complex MA, leveraged finance, and equity capital markets transactions across the business, industrial, and professional services landscape. articles.summary: Greg Han Joins as Managing Director in New York Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Greg Han has joined as a Managing Director in its Power, Utilities, and Renewables Group. Based in New York, Mr. Han will focus on advising corporate and financial sponsor clients across the power and utilities sectors, including conventional power generation and renewable energy. Mr. Han brings more than 20 years of investment banking experience to the firm. Most recently, he served as a Managing Director at Rothschild Co., where he led the firm’s North American power, utilities, and renewables advisory practice, growing its presence in one of the firm’s core global infrastructure verticals. articles.summary: Transaction Further Strengthens Existing Coverage Capabilities in Beauty, Personal Care, and Pet Health Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, has agreed to acquire Vicente Partners, a premier independent advisory firm with deep expertise in the beauty, personal care, and pet health sectors across Europe and the United States. The transaction was signed on 30 October 2026. Vicente Partners was established in London in 2020 by Alejandro Vicente, the former Global Head of Consumer Goods Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan. Mr. Vicente has more than 30 years of fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) experience, including 17 years at J.P. Morgan and eight years in senior roles at large corporates. He will join Houlihan Lokey as a Managing Director, alongside fellow Partners Lidiia Gaiduk and Michelle Garcia.
